question: Can NetMint verify historical token supply on Solana (xStocks' main chain)?
source: live call to https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com (public Solana RPC). The docs page https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/gettokensupply answered HTTP 429 to our fetch on 2026-11-21, so this finding rests on the live calls below, not on the docs text.
finding: getTokenSupply returns the CURRENT supply with the current context slot. Passing a past slot (300000000) in the config is silently ignored: both calls return the same context.slot and amount. Standard Solana JSON-RPC gives NetMint no way to read a mint's supply at a past day boundary.
consequence: Solana legs are reported as 'not verifiable on chain' (NVDAX: 9.7% of CMC total supply sits on Ethereum + BNB Smart Chain, coverage.json); no NVDAX inflow verdict is issued from Solana supply.
